raw: {"analysis":"JKS correctly identifies the two-senior-engineer approval requirement and provides a feature-flag rollback that avoids the irreversible full database rollback. SHQ only requires one senior engineer for review (violating the deployment approval constraint) and proposes an automated merge to main, which conflicts with the explicit two-approval gate. JKS also better handles the config-only CI cost avoidance and the flaky staging network check, while both address memory/session eviction and the Platform team config lock adequately."," "verdict": "JKS"}
